title: synth.english_bell~
description: `synth.english_bell~` is a modal-model synthesizer for an English church bell, producing an audio signal from a model with seven linearly arranged excitation positions. Trigger it with a bang or the `@gate` property, and shape the strike and resonance with properties including position, cutoff, gain, sharpness, decay ratio, decay slope, and T60 decay time.
